newsitem.title: CANADA: Seagram renews share repurchase program.
newsitem.headline: Seagram renews share repurchase program.

text.p: Seagram Co. Ltd. said Friday its board of directors renewed the company's share repurchase programme, authorising the company to buy up to 3 percent of its common shares outstanding.
The producer of spirits and wines and entertainment company said it will buy back up to 11.1 million of its 370.5 million shares outstanding in the open market over the course of the next year.
Under the company's previous share repurchase programme that terminates next week, 4.9 million shares have been purchased at an average price of US$32.62.
Seagram's stock closed Thursday at $34.75 on the New York Stock Exchange.
